findings.summaryEn: Real NASA experiments show space plants grow fresh vitamins for astronauts, but low water or high radiation makes leaves wilt fast.
findings.summaryUz: Haqiqiy NASA tajribalari kosmik o'simliklar vitamin berishini, lekin kam suv yoki radiatsiya barglarni tez so'ldirishini ko'rsatdi.
findings.source: NASA OSDR Dataset OSD-120 / ISS Veggie

findings.summaryEn: Without Earth's thick air and magnetic shield, cosmic radiation damages DNA. Water walls and regolith dirt block harmful rays!
findings.summaryUz: Yerning qalin atmosferasi va magnit qalqonisiz kosmik radiatsiya DNKga zarar yetkazadi. Suv devorlari va regolit tuprog'i nurlarni to'sadi!
findings.source: NASA OSDR Space Biology Radiation Studies

findings.summaryEn: Astronauts in lower gravity need clean air, steady nutrition, and daily exercise to keep their hearts and bones strong.
findings.summaryUz: Past gravitatsiyada astronavtlar yuragi va suyaklari baquvvat bo'lishi uchun toza havo va to'g'ri ovqatlanish shart.
